intro: Twenty-eight articles published between April 13 and May 20, 2026, cover the privilege-escalation tag, with a severity mix of three medium, twenty-one high, and four critical reports. The threat actor Chaotic Eclipse was observed in these incidents. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-8950, CVE-2026-8956, and CVE-2026-8957, each with a CVSS score of 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34659 and CVE-2026-34660, both scoring 9.6. Affected sectors span enterprise, technology, education, government, and healthcare, with impacts reported globally and across North America.
